data.name: Danger Sense
data.description: You gain a +%1 bonus on Reflex saves to avoid traps and a +%1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks by traps. In addition, you gain a +%1 bonus on Perception checks to avoid being surprised by a foe. This ability counts as trap sense for any feat or class prerequisite, and can be replaced by any archetype class feature that replaces trap sense. The bonuses gained from this ability stack with those gained from trap sense (if you have trap sense from another class).|TrapSenseBonus
